summary: Zerg builds autonomous software-engineering systems — agents that write, test, and fix code in production. We want builders who turn frontier AI research into shipping products: strong engineers with research instincts, comfortable across ML and systems, who think about user/business intent and not just metrics.
must_haves: Strong software engineering: ships real, working software (not just notebooks/prototypes)
ML/AI depth: LLMs, agents, RL, or distributed ML — can read papers and implement them
Evidence of building: GitHub, shipped products, papers, or demos
nice_to_haves: Agentic systems, RL/RLHF, world models, or inference-time compute
Distributed/parallel ML, performance/kernels, or systems work
Has founded or been early at a startup; high agency / 0-to-1
negative_signals: Marty pattern: optimizes without context — technically correct but misses user/business intent (see Personas/Marty)
Pure prompt-engineering / no-code AI with no real engineering depth
Title inflation or claims with no evidence in work history
seniority: open (intern through senior); calibrate score to evidence, not years
calibration_anchor: Franklin Yiu scored 4.4/5 overall and was a clear hire: first-author EXAG 2025 paper, modern stack (PyTorch/JAX/DSPy), strong research-to-code translation. Treat ~4.4 as 'strong reach-out'.
